Judgement of the delta. Lost assertion restored and stronger: the old check compared the day text, the new check bounds each entry between the instance UTC instant before the question and after the read, so a stamp off by hours or outside the request window fails, while the day check passed it. Midnight and zone: both bounds and the entry are UTC instants, so a day boundary inside the window does not matter and no zone conversion is involved. Fails on a wrong time: yes, unless the bracket holds the stamp. Caveat: a frozen clock makes the bracket a point, which still passes only for the exact stamp; no flake was observed.
